mechanisms.name: dendrite arm spacing dependence on temperature gradient and solidification rate

evidence.section: 4.1 Effect of the solidification method on the microstructure
evidence.quote: The LMC method contains a higher temperature gradient and solidification rate than the HRS method. The solidification rate is approximately equal to the moving rate of the solid-liquid interface. Thus, the difference of the dendrite spacing in the magnitude of 3 times can be derived

mechanisms.name: reduced dendrite segregation by shorter diffusion distance and shorter diffusion time

evidence.section: 4.1 Effect of the solidification method on the microstructure
evidence.quote: The dendrite spacing is the diffusion distance, the lower distance in the sample prepared using the LMC method will produce lighter segregation. In addition, higher G and V increase the cooling rate, which will contribute to a short diffusion time. This can also lead to lighter segregation

mechanisms.name: gamma prime refinement by higher cooling rate

evidence.section: 4.1 Effect of the solidification method on the microstructure
evidence.quote: The higher cooling rate also contributes to the smaller size of gʹ phases and elements ' partition ratio for their lower growth time

mechanisms.name: Re retardation of element diffusion and gamma prime coarsening

evidence.section: 4.2 Effect of composition on the microstructure
evidence.quote: As a heavy element, the addition of Re will decrease the diffusion coefficient of elements in the alloy, thus inhibiting the diffusion of dendritic elements to inter-dendrite after solidification, resulting in the aggravation of dendrite segregation

mechanisms.name: Co and Cr enhancement of element diffusion

evidence.section: 4.2 Effect of composition on the microstructure
evidence.quote: Co and Cr have high diffusion coefficients to promote element diffusion, thus reducing the dendritic segregation. In this regard, alloy-2 contains lower dendrite segregation than alloy-1.

mechanisms.name: gamma prime re-dissolution by small gamma prime size and low partition ratio

evidence.section: 4.3 Effect of microstructure on the solution heat treatment window
evidence.quote: The smaller size of g0 phase and elements ' partition ratio can help improve the re-dissolution of g0 phase, and this help reduces the lower limit temperature of the solution window and broadens the solution window.

mechanisms.name: eutectic composition control of incipient melting temperature

evidence.section: 4.3 Effect of microstructure on the solution heat treatment window
evidence.quote: The effect of alloy elements on the initial melting temperature is mainly reflected in the composition of the eutectic structure. Due to the influence of alloy composition, the eutectic structure of alloy-2 has higher Co and Cr content and lower Re content than alloy-1.
